items.title: Of everything you've edited, how much is actually at risk switching branches?
items.description: L2's per-file rule: an uncommitted edit is only at risk (refused, or silently at-risk-if-force-discarded) if the target branch's committed version of that file also differs from yours. Set how many files you've edited and what fraction also diverge on the target branch to see how few of your total edited files are actually affected — the rest (always files you've edited minus the at-risk count) silently carry over untouched.

params.name: pctDivergedInTarget
params.label: % of those files that also differ on the target branch

items.compute:
const filesAtRisk = Math.round(params.totalFilesEdited * params.pctDivergedInTarget / 100);
return { filesAtRisk };
